Title: Public preview - Support for multiple currencies on Retail Rates API for all Azure products/services

Body.Content:
Azure customers have been looking for a programmatic way to retrieve retail prices for all Azure services in different currencies. Azure Retail Prices API now has the capability to return prices in different currencies. Previously, you would see prices only in USD. This API gives you an unauthenticated experience to get retail rates for all Azure services. 

Learn more.
